transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in?

Honestly, I've just been feeling incredibly depressed and sad lately. It feels like there's this constant emptiness inside me, and I've felt this way for about 11 months now. I just really don't know what to do anymore.
Did these feelings start after a specific stressful life event or major change, or did they come on without a clear trigger?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. There wasn't any specific event or trigger that I can think of. It just seemed to start on its own and has been getting worse.
Over these 11 months, have you felt depressed most of the day, more days than not, pretty consistently, or have there been shorter episodes with times in between when you felt mostly back to normal?

No, there haven't been any times where I felt back to normal. I've felt persistently depressed and sad almost every single day for the entire 11 months. It has just been completely constant without any breaks.

Along with feeling depressed, have you also had symptoms like loss of interest or pleasure, changes in sleep or appetite, low energy, trouble concentrating, feelings of worthlessness, or thoughts of death? If so, have several of these been present during the same 2-week period?

Yes, my sleep has been completely ruined; I have a really hard time falling asleep, wake up constantly throughout the night, and have awful nightmares. As for things like my appetite, concentration, or thoughts of death, I'm not really sure about those.
Have you been through or witnessed something traumatic, and are the nightmares about that event or do you also get unwanted memories or flashbacks of it?

No, I haven't experienced or witnessed any major traumatic events, and I don't get any flashbacks or unwanted memories like that. However, I do suffer from really frequent, distressing nightmares almost every night, even if they aren't about a specific trauma.
Before this 11-month period, had you already been feeling down most days for at least another year, or did this depressed mood truly begin about 11 months ago?
No, I didn't feel like this before. This depressed mood and everything else truly started about 11 months ago, and before that, I was doing just fine.

During this 11-month period, have there been at least 2 weeks when you also clearly lost interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy, or had other symptoms like low energy, poor concentration, appetite change, or feelings of worthlessness at the same time?

I've definitely been feeling deeply sad, depressed, and empty for the last 11 months. However, I haven't really experienced those other symptoms like a loss of interest in things, low energy, poor concentration, appetite changes, or feelings of worthlessness.
How much has this depressed mood affected your daily life, like your work, relationships, or ability to take care of things day to day?

I'm not quite sure, and I haven't really thought about how much it has affected my relationships or daily tasks specifically. I just know that I've been feeling incredibly down and empty for about 11 months now.
During the same 2-week period, besides depressed mood and insomnia, did you have either a clear loss of interest or pleasure in things, or thoughts that life wasn’t worth living?

No, I haven't really felt that way. I haven't lost interest in my usual activities, and I've never had thoughts that life isn't worth living. Mostly, I am just struggling with this deep sadness and my terrible sleep issues.
Around the time this started, was there any ongoing stress in your life—like relationship, work, financial, or health problems—even if there wasn’t one single major event?

No, I can't really recall any ongoing stress like that around the time this started. My work, relationships, and finances were all pretty normal back then. It really just seemed to happen out of nowhere.
